A.title: Single point of contact is leaving
A.text: Every call since May has been with Rhys Calder alone, and he leaves the programme in January with no successor named. The renewal (28 Feb 2027, no automatic renewal, £350k) has no other sponsor on our side. Evidence: champion_leaves signal, profile, calls_index.

A.title: Only about half the docks are really used
A.text: October flight log: Westmere 14 of 18 docks on live missions, Metro Central only 3 of 9 (down from 8 in August), Tarn Valley 0 of 4 ever, Norwold training only. About 17 of 35 docks earn their keep, which contradicts 'all four forces are keen'. Evidence: flight_log_force_month, rc_appetite_2, rc_appetite_0.

A.title: Reply to Karen in writing this week
A.text: Own ticket FB-11206 today. Send Insp. Karen Mbeki in writing this week: dates for training more operators before 5 December, and a named contact and response time if a dock fails on the day. Also answer her unanswered 11 Aug battery email: docks D16 and D29 show repeated battery warnings. Evidence: urgent_request signal, emails/2026-08-11, device_events.

A.title: Widen contacts before Rhys leaves
A.text: Before January: get named contacts at Westmere, Metro Central, Tarn Valley and Norwold, and at the alliance procurement lead. Find the owner and content of FB-10412 (document request from a force, unowned since 29 June). Ask FlytBase Accounts for Schedule 2 to see what each force pays. Evidence: profile not_on_file, tickets FB-10412, contract.

B.title: Night patrols collapsing
B.text: Only 4 of 14 docks ever patrolled most nights (AD-02, AD-05, AD-08, AD-10). 9 docks fly about once a fortnight and AD-14 has never flown. In mid-November AD-02, AD-05 and AD-10 stopped completely while online. No ticket, nobody at the customer said anything. This contradicts 'thirteen of fifteen plants are flying'. Evidence: usage_drop signal, usage_weekly, sr_roll_0.

B.title: Protect the insurance discount with Julian Tate
B.text: Meet Julian Tate (insurance and risk) to confirm the 6% premium cut across nine plants (~€180k a year) and what patrol level the insurer expects. This is the only verified financial benefit and is larger than the contract value (€140k). Build the renewal case on it instead of the unproven €1.2M claim. Evidence: jt_prem_2, sr_roi_0.

B.title: Capture the rollout know-how before the deputy leaves
B.text: Before Stefan Roy's deputy leaves: get the install list (which dock is at which plant, who was trained), the patrol schedules and alert recipients written down. Ask Owen Fitch (IT) to fix the Plant 11 network link (FB-10903, pending since September). Evidence: sr_repl_2, ba_deputy_0, ba_other_1, rollout close call notes.

B.title: Answer Group Finance with cost and value per plant
B.text: Reply to Group Finance's 8 October request with the renewal cost per plant alongside usage and value per plant, so idle docks are discussed openly rather than cut blindly. Agree the renewal scope before 31 Jan 2027. Evidence: emails/2026-10-08_finance_mailbox, ba_cost_2, usage_weekly.

K.title: Paid, never flown, board vote on 17 Nov
K.text: Kestrel Estates paid £14,000 for one dock (KE-D01). It has flown zero times in 7 weeks online and was never commissioned. Residents already ask why they paid. The residents' board votes on the security budget on 17 Nov. Evidence: usage_weekly.csv, devices.json, k_board_doubts_14b, k_board_pays_14b.

K.title: Go-live plan to Dana by 16 Nov
K.text: Call Dana Whitfield, apologise for no reply since 19 Oct, and agree a written go-live plan for night patrols of the north gate: insurer declared, commissioning flight booked, two staff trained. Evidence: emails/2026-10-19_dana_when.txt, k_need_entrances_14b.

K.title: Declare the dock to the insurer before any flight
K.text: Ask Lucy Pratt (broker) to notify the insurer about the dock before use, as the property insurance requires. Evidence: k_insurer_not_told_14b, K_insurance_schedule_14b.

K.title: Pilot certification for two estate staff (£4,000)
K.text: Offer the pilot certification course to Dana for two staff. Without it nobody at the estate can fly the dock. Needs a board vote (Graham Okafor). Evidence: k_training_14b, k_no_pilot_14b, k_board_pays_14b.

H.title: Finance won't renew on an unseen saving
H.text: Priya Nair (finance director) signs the £96,000 renewal (ends 12 Apr 2027) and will not renew on a saving she cannot see. The £400,000 is Marcus Hale's own estimate; no patrol contract changed. Only 2 of 6 docks fly nightly. Evidence: h_finance_renewal_14b, h_saving_basis_14b, usage_weekly.csv.

H.title: Answer Elena's privacy request (FB-10231)
H.text: Send Elena Varga the data retention and storage details she asked for on 14 Apr 2026. Unanswered for 7 months; it blocks the container yard dock (up to £30,000). Evidence: FB-10231, h_vendor_silent_14b, h_yard_blocked_14b.

H.title: Write down Tom's know-how before he leaves
H.text: Before Tom Reyes's contract ends (~14 Dec), capture launch steps, patrol routes, the alert rota and which dock sits where. Offer Marcus the £12,000 playbook. Evidence: h_contractor_leaving_14b, h_rollout_pack_14b.

H.title: Brief IT before the yard network change
H.text: Give Sam Okoye the docks' network needs before yard devices move to the segmented network (~Feb 2027). IT was never involved in the installs. Evidence: h_segmentation_14b, h_it_not_involved_14b.
